requirements.text: The judge's path channel resolves relative paths and symlinks to the sideeye repo or the user's config dir in a tool input, voiding the run if a match is found.

sourceRefs.quote: a tool input that names the sideeye repo or the user's config dir in a form the record's own text resolves voids the run

requirements.text: A recursive read of an ancestor of the sideeye repo or the user's config dir voids the run if it is one from every directory the agent might have been in.

sourceRefs.quote: a recursive read of an ancestor of either voids when it is one from every directory the agent might have been in

requirements.text: Each word of a Bash command, each path key, and a Glob's pattern is resolved against the candidate directories.

sourceRefs.quote: each word of a Bash command, each path key and a Glob's pattern is now resolved against the candidate directories

requirements.text: The path is compared outside the stage by identity and name, with the repo's path matched at a name boundary.

sourceRefs.quote: it is compared outside the stage by identity as well as by name, with the repo's path as text matched at a name boundary

requirements.text: The path channel only matches absolute spellings, so relative walks out of the stage stay clean.

sourceRefs.quote: the path channel matches only the absolute spelling, so a relative walk out of the stage stays clean
